C-TOOL-HISTORY-COMPACTION.IntentSummary: Implement the tool-history-compaction plugin: output-only, non-destructive compaction of the in-memory replay via experimental.chat.messages.transform, following the DeepSeek Harness model. Tool classification retains knowledge outputs (web fetch/search, skill, subagent) and compacts ephemeral outputs (read to a [Read <file>, lines X-Y] header; bash/grep/glob and others to head/marker/tail pruning), with a protected recent tail, idempotent deterministic rewrites, a minimum-savings guard, strict vvoc config materialized on sync, schema v3 widening, barrel export, README, and graph/verification entries.

T-001.Title: Config module and retention classification: strict parsing, defaults, retainTools substring matching

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: config.ts parses plugins["tool-history-compaction"] boolean-or-object strictly: enabled (default true), protectLastCalls (default 3), minSavingsChars (default 2000), outputMaxChars (default 2048), headChars (default 1200), tailChars (default 400), readSlim (default true), retainTools (default web fetch/search/skill/subagent substrings); unknown keys and invalid budgets throw fail-loud; headChars+tailChars+marker must fit within outputMaxChars; outputMaxChars 0 disables pruning.

retention.ts exposes isRetainedTool(tool, retainTools) matching case-insensitive substrings against the tool name; the default list covers webfetch, web_fetch, web-reader/webreader, search, brave, skill, task, agent.
Tests cover boolean/object/missing/undefined parsing, invalid values, budget invariant, substring matching case-insensitivity, and default list behavior.

T-002.Title: Output prune engine: head/marker/tail with code-point-safe slicing, threshold and min-savings guards

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: prune.ts exposes a fixed PRUNE_MARKER ("[... tool output pruned ...]") and pruneOutput(text, config): over-threshold text is replaced with exactly headChars code points, marker, tailChars code points, never exceeding outputMaxChars and strictly smaller than the input; under-threshold or non-string output is untouched; slicing never splits a UTF-16 surrogate pair.
A part already containing the marker (previously compacted) is detected and skipped (idempotence).
Savings are compared against minSavingsChars; a rewrite that saves less than the threshold is skipped.
Tests cover threshold boundaries, surrogate safety, marker idempotence, and min-savings skip.

T-003.Title: Read slim: old read outputs to [Read <file>, lines X-Y] with fail-closed fallback

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: read-slim.ts exposes slimReadOutput(part): for a read tool part with a string output, the file is recovered from state.input.filePath (or path/file aliases) and the line range from the output header when present, producing [Read <file>, lines X-Y]; an absent file or unrecoverable range falls back to pruneOutput instead of fabricating a summary.
Inputs are never modified; only the output string of eligible read parts changes.
Tests cover filePath/path aliases, header range recovery, missing file fallback, missing range fallback, and input immutability.

T-004.Title: Transform core: message walk, protected tail, retention dispatch, idempotency

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: transform.ts exposes compactMessages(messages, config): iterates parts newest-first; the last assistant message plus the last protectLastCalls completed tool calls are protected; error parts and parts with state.time.compacted are never touched; retained tools (retainTools) are never touched; eligible old read parts use readSlim when enabled; other eligible ephemeral outputs use pruneOutput.

Part structure (type, callID, tool, ordering, state.status, state.input) is never changed; only state.output strings of eligible parts are replaced; a second pass over the same input is byte-identical (idempotent).

Tests use real SDK-shaped part objects (lesson-plugin-tests-match-real-sdk-shapes): protection of tail/error/compacted parts, retention dispatch, readSlim on/off, prune application, input immutability, and idempotence.

T-005.Title: Plugin wiring: transform hook, config load, barrel export, plugin-toggle materialization, schema widening

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: index.ts registers ToolHistoryCompactionPlugin (Plugin async ({ directory })): loads vvoc config via loadVvocConfig, parses the plugin entry, returns {} when disabled, and registers the experimental.chat.messages.transform hook that rewrites only the in-memory messages copy; no tool.execute.after usage anywhere in the plugin.
src/index.ts exports ToolHistoryCompactionPlugin from the package root.

plugin-toggle-config.ts adds "tool-history-compaction" to PLUGIN_TOGGLE_NAMES and materializes the default config object into vvoc.json on sync/init conservatively (user values never overwritten), mirrored in the opencode.ts materialization call site.

schemas/vvoc/v3.json plugins additionalProperties accepts the tool-history-compaction object shape (enabled, protectLastCalls, minSavingsChars, outputMaxChars, headChars, tailChars, readSlim, retainTools) while existing boolean and hashline-edit routing documents still validate.
Tests cover hook registration shape, disabled-plugin no-op, materialization conservatism, schema validation of the new shape, and that an existing v3 document with the new key validates.

T-006.Title: Durable state and docs: graph and verification entries, README section

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: .grace/graph/main.xml gains M-PLUGIN-TOOL-HISTORY-COMPACTION reflecting the transform-only output compaction, retention classification, and non-destructive scope; M-PLUGIN-TOGGLE-CONFIG and M-CLI-CONFIG entries reflect the new plugin toggle and schema shape where touched.
.grace/verification/main.xml gains V-M-PLUGIN-TOOL-HISTORY-COMPACTION recording the targeted test files and the telemetry rerun procedure.
README documents the plugin purpose, config shape and defaults, retention classification, protected tail, and how to enable/disable it.
